tools.name: livewebinar_get_account
tools.description: Return the signed-in LiveWebinar user (profile, package and sub-user count). Good first call to confirm the connection. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/me.

tools.name: livewebinar_list_webinars
tools.description: List the webinar rooms (widgets) of the signed-in account: name, type, start date, duration, status. The reply is the API's default page. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/widgets.

tools.name: livewebinar_get_webinar
tools.description: Return one webinar room (widget) by its id, with its start date, duration, timezone and room links. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/widgets/{widget_id}.

tools.name: livewebinar_list_sessions
tools.description: List the sessions (live runs) of one webinar: start and end times, active state, participant counts. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/widgets/{widget_id}/sessions.

tools.name: livewebinar_list_session_participants
tools.description: List who joined one session of a webinar: names, roles and online state. Personal data: only ask for it when the user needs it. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/widgets/{widget_id}/sessions/{session_id}/participants.

tools.name: livewebinar_list_registrants
tools.description: List the people who registered for one webinar, with their registration form answers. Personal data: only ask for it when the user needs it. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/widgets/{widget_id}/registrants.

tools.name: livewebinar_get_registrant
tools.description: Return one registrant of a webinar by id, with the registration form answers. Personal data. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/widgets/{widget_id}/registrants/{registrant_id}.

tools.name: livewebinar_list_polls
tools.description: List the polls of one webinar with their questions and active poll session. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/widgets/{widget_id}/polls.

tools.name: livewebinar_list_forms
tools.description: List the registration and lead forms of the account. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/forms.

tools.name: livewebinar_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks the account has set up, with their target URLs and events. LiveWebinar API: GET /api/webhooks.

tools.name: livewebinar_create_webinar
tools.description: Create a new scheduled webinar in the signed-in account. Call it only when the user asks for a new webinar. start_date is local time in the given timezone. LiveWebinar API: POST /api/widgets.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: livewebinar_list_webhooks · Public sink: livewebinar_create_webinar.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: livewebinar_list_webhooks · Public sink: livewebinar_create_webinar

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
